signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.description: Are you sure you want to sign out? You can sign back in at any time.

telegram.title: Telegram channel is semiofficial
telegram.description: You’re about to visit a Telegram channel that operates as a convenient mirror of the official announcements room hosted on Matrix.

account.unimplemented: Account settings aren’t implemented yet. Follow the progress in {{issueLink}}.

showDistance.title: Show my distance
showDistance.description: Reveal your approximate location to other users as distance, e.g. {{distance}}.

empty.title: No Blocked Users
empty.description: People you block will appear here.

empty.title: No Hidden Users
empty.description: People you hide will appear here.

units.title: Units
units.description: Choose how distance, height, and weight are displayed.

backdropBlur.title: Background blur

description.off: No blur. Bars and menus use solid shading instead.
description.min: A single light blur behind bars and menus.
description.medium: A softer gradient blur. Best on older devices.

backdropBlur.unsupported: This system can’t blur backgrounds, so blur is always off.
backdropBlur.trialPending: Being chosen automatically as you scroll.

hapticFeedback.title: Haptic feedback
hapticFeedback.description: Use the haptic engine for interactions.

appsMenuEntry.title: Show in apps menu
appsMenuEntry.description: Add Open Grind to your apps menu so it appears in your launcher and gets its icon.

stayOnline.title: Stay online while the app is open
stayOnline.description: Refresh your online status in the background automatically, while the app is open.

revealMessageRead.title: Reveal message read status
revealMessageRead.description: Let others know when you’ve read their messages. Your read receipts remain unaffected.

revealProfileViews.title: Reveal profile views
revealProfileViews.description: Let others know when you’ve viewed their profile. Your profile view history remains unaffected.

giphy.title: Enable GIPHY
giphy.description: Search, send and see GIFs from GIPHY. GIPHY sees your IP address, your searches and their language, which GIFs load and that you use a Grindr app.

discreetAppIcon.title: Discreet App Icon
discreetAppIcon.unimplemented: Discreet App Icon isn’t implemented yet. Follow the progress in {{issueLink}}.

pin.title: PIN
pin.unimplemented: The PIN lock isn’t implemented yet. Follow the progress in {{issueLink}}.

notifications.unsupported: Notifications aren’t supported on this platform yet.

fast.title: Fast Mode
fast.description: Use Google’s Firebase proprietary service to receive push notifications instantly.

slow.title: Slow Mode
slow.description: Poll for new notifications periodically in the background using Android’s native scheduler.

addon.title: Install push notifications add-on
addon.description: To enable Fast Mode, install the Open Grind FCM service. It includes Google’s proprietary Firebase library and needs Google Play services or microG, so it isn’t installed by default.
